link.04f098ead5ad.source: Fleet dynamics and containment. What changes when N agents run in parallel: each agent redundantly re-discovers the same context (rediscovery cost), topologies with too many hops lose coherence, and an agent grading a peer's output can shift its verdicts based on social context rather than content. How to bound any single agent in the fleet with kernel-level containment (Landlock, seccomp, network namespaces) when prompt rules and guardrails are not enough to limit blast radius.
link.04f098ead5ad.value: 代理程式群動態與隔離。當 N 個代理程式並行執行階段會發生哪些變化：每個代理程式都會重複發現相同的上下文（重複發現成本）；包含過多跳轉的拓撲會失去連貫性；負責評判同伴輸出的代理程式可能會因社交語境而非內容本身改變結論。當提示詞規則和防護機制不足以限制影響範圍時，如何使用核心級隔離（Landlock、seccomp、網路名稱空間）約束代理程式群中的任一代理程式。

link.280a9b763731.source: NeMo Retriever is the production successor to the cosine similarity retrieval from Module 2b. Pair it with NIM-served embeddings for a fully on-prem retrieval stack that keeps data inside your VPC.

link.7d5ef990fdf0.source: A single strong agent is the default. A single strong agent beats a multi-agent system once a task crosses a threshold of complexity (Chen et al., 2024). Push N higher and the emergent behaviours can hurt more than the failure modes you set out to fix. Before adding one more to the topology, name the specific failure mode it is meant to fix. If you can't name it, the extra complexity is unlikely to help.
link.7d5ef990fdf0.value: 預設選擇是使用單個強大的代理程式。當任務複雜度超過某個閾值後，單個強大的代理程式會勝過多代理程式系統（Chen et al., 2024）。繼續增加 N，湧現行為造成的危害可能會超過您原本試圖修復的故障模式。向拓撲中再新增一個代理程式之前，請明確指出它要解決的具體故障模式。如果無法明確說明，增加複雜度就不太可能有所幫助。

link.cbf92af9743d.source: Forecasts about agent productivity are systematically wrong. METR's randomised trial of experienced open-source developers found a meaningful slowdown from using a coding agent, even though they expected to go faster and reported afterward that they had. That distance between forecast and measured result is the finding to carry forward, so weigh it when scoping the value of any agent you ship.
link.cbf92af9743d.value: 對代理程式生產力的預測往往存在系統性偏差。 METR 針對資深開源開發者開展的隨機試驗發現，使用 coding 代理程式會導致顯著減速，儘管參與者原本預計效率會提高，並且事後也報告稱自己的效率有所提高。預測與實測結果之間的差距才是需要牢記的發現。因此，在評估您所部署的任何代理程式的價值時，都應將這一點納入考量。

rich.ccf9b06295c5.source:
The agent's admin token is a higher perimeter than the sandbox. The kernel sandbox bounds what the agent can do to the world, yet it says nothing about whoever holds the agent's operator token. That holder sits above the boundary entirely, free to do any of the following:

  • read the persona
  • plant cron jobs
  • patch the model and its tools
  • inject a turn into the conversation

The hardness of the box and the scope of that token are separate measurements.

Module 4b showed the token reaching past the checkpoint the sandbox never sees. Treat an operator.admin credential like a root password: tight storage and regular rotation. For that agent it reaches further than root does inside the box.
rich.ccf9b06295c5.value:
代理程式的管理員 token 位於比沙箱更高的邊界。核心沙箱限制了代理程式能夠對外部環境執行的操作，卻無法約束掌握代理程式 operator token 的人。該持有者完全位於這一邊界之上，可以自由執行以下任何操作：

  • 讀取角色設定
  • 植入 cron 任務
  • patch 模型及其工具
  • 向對話中注入一輪訊息

沙箱的堅固程度與該 token 的權限範圍是兩個相互獨立的衡量指標。

模組 4b 展示了 token 如何越過沙箱根本無法看到的檢查點。應像對待 root 密碼一樣保護 operator.admin 憑證：嚴格保管並定期輪換。對於該代理程式而言，這項憑證的權限範圍甚至超過了沙箱內部的 root。

rich.d9a1d134866b.source: Transfer the interface contract, then adapt the environment. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, visible state, and approval controls travel well. Authentication, cross-origin access, persistence, filesystem reach, backend tools, and host UI bridges do not. Keep those dependencies behind narrow adapters so the workflow can move without pretending every host grants the same authority.
rich.d9a1d134866b.value: 遷移介面契約，再適配環境。 HTML、CSS、JavaScript、可見狀態和審批控制元件都易於遷移。身分驗證、跨域存取、持久化、檔案系統存取範圍、後端工具和主機 UI 橋接則不然。請將這些依賴置於精簡的介面卡之後，使工作流程能夠遷移，同時避免假定每種主機都授予相同權限。

rich.e9b653317b4a.source: The substrate. Wire-format protocols (MCP, the Responses API, OTel GenAI conventions, A2A) that keep tool capabilities portable across providers and frameworks.
rich.e9b653317b4a.value: 基礎層。線格式協議（MCP、Responses API、OTel GenAI 約定和 A2A），用於保持工具能力在不同提供商和框架之間的可移植性。

rich.ecf9625a3e81.source:
Kernel containment answers what survives a successful prompt injection. Prompt rules and application guardrails help, but they only act on what the model exposes to them, and an injected instruction that looks valid will pass straight through.

Any agent that can touch a real shell or filesystem or reach the network therefore needs a layer beneath the prompt. That layer enforces its rules at the syscall boundary, below the level any instruction can reach.
rich.ecf9625a3e81.value:
核心級隔離決定了提示詞注入成功後仍有哪些防護有效。提示詞規則和應用防護機制雖有幫助，但它們只能處理模型向其暴露的內容；看似有效的注入指令會直接透過這些防線。

因此，任何能夠操作真實 shell 或檔案系統，或者能夠存取網路的代理程式，都需要在提示詞之下另設一層防護。該層在系統呼叫邊界執行規則，位置低於任何指令能夠觸及的層級。
